note: The relational fact vocabulary of chess (plan 78.24): the lemma vocabulary of vocabulary.json plus the human concepts of rules/concepts/chess.gdl and the relations between units of rules/concepts/chess_units.gdl (composed in that order onto the description): distances between a king and another unit (apart, with the static closer to say a distance shrank), the king's flight squares, the opposition, a pawn's steps to promotion, its king ahead of it, the square of the pawn. A move's effect is read on cell and on these relations; attack is not in delta (a single move changes dozens of its facts).
